rules: Use lowercase snake_case.
Prefix all semantic models with 'sm_'.
Name should reflect business domain and metric.
Avoid abbreviations unless industry-standard (e.g., OEE).
KPIs must be prefixed with 'kpi_'.
KPIs must map directly to a semantic model.
KPI names must match dictionary entries exactly.
Facts represent business events or transactions.
Use 'fact_' prefix for all fact tables.
Name should reflect the event being recorded.
Dimensions represent entities or attributes.
Use 'dim_' prefix for all dimension tables.
Pluralize dimension names (e.g., dim_items).
Aggregates must be prefixed with 'agg_'.
Grain must be included (daily, weekly, monthly).
Aggregates must reference semantic models, not facts.
Validation rules must be prefixed with 'val_'.
Validation names must describe the check being performed.
Logging tables must be prefixed with 'log_'.
Logging names must reflect the event type.

general_rules: Use lowercase snake_case for all names.
Names must be deterministic and stable over time.
Names must reflect business meaning, not technical implementation.
Every semantic model must map to at least one KPI or downstream consumer.
Every KPI must map to exactly one semantic model.
